4.5 stars. 117 reviews. And most tourists walk straight past Chùa Sùng Đức without a second glance.

This Buddhist temple in Phú Quốc is the kind of place that slows you down. Incense in the air. Quiet courtyards. Zero tour buses.

If your Phu Quoc itinerary is all beaches and bars, carve out one morning for this. You'll leave feeling reset.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Stepping inside Chùa Sùng Đức while the rest of the island sleeps in. Incense smoke, golden shrines, and a courtyard so quiet you hear your own footsteps. This is Phu Quoc at 8am.
